_comment: Ek naya game add karna ho to bas neechay array mein ek naya { } object add kar dein aur uska icon file (jaise icon-<id>.svg ya .png) isi folder ke root mein upload kar dein. Website automatically naya card dikha dega — kisi HTML/CSS ko chhedne ki zaroorat nahi.
